library: Shopee BR — case history, relist freeze and authorisation
source_excerpt: Anúncios banidos podem ser restabelecidos assim que a violação for resolvida. Anúncios excluídos pela Shopee não podem ser recuperados e incorrerão pontos no sistema de Pontos de Penalidade do Vendedor da Shopee. Itens com o alcance limitado também retornam assim que houver a correção indicada.
notes: These rules use sentinel triggers: the relist and duplicate engines inject a token into the field under inspection, because the verdict comes from a cross-record comparison that a text pattern cannot express. The rule then governs severity, decision and required evidence.

rules.title: Listing is attached to an open violation case
rules.description: The product is already associated with a case that the platform has not closed. A banned listing can be restored once the violation is resolved, and a listing with limited reach returns once the indicated correction is made — so the listing must not be treated as clean while its case is open. This rule raises the listing for a human decision; it does not by itself block.
rules.source_excerpt: Itens com o alcance limitado também retornam assim que houver a correção indicada.
rules.notes: Sentinel trigger. The reviewer injects __OPEN_CASE_SIGNAL__ when the product id appears in a case whose status is open/under_review/awaiting_evidence. The distinction matters: an enforced case freezes (SBR-DUP-003), an open case only asks for a review.

rules.title: Listing was removed by the platform and cannot be recovered
rules.description: A listing deleted by Shopee cannot be recovered and incurs penalty points; a banned listing can be restored only once the violation is resolved. Re-submitting a removed listing therefore has to be blocked until the original case is closed and the operator has approved the remediation.
rules.source_excerpt: Anúncios excluídos pela Shopee não podem ser recuperados e incorrerão pontos no sistema de Pontos de Penalidade do Vendedor da Shopee.
rules.notes: Sentinel trigger, injected when the product id appears in a case whose status records a platform removal (blocked/relist_frozen/escalated/rejected).

rules.title: Restricted item published without complete authorisation evidence
rules.description: A restricted-category item may only be listed with the supporting documentation the platform requires. When the authorisation file is incomplete — for example an invoice but no ANVISA registration for a health product — the listing must not go live on the documentation it has.
rules.source_excerpt: O vendedor é responsável por garantir que os produtos anunciados estejam em conformidade com a legislação brasileira, com as normas dos órgãos reguladores aplicáveis e com as políticas da Shopee.
rules.notes: The product's `history.authorization_documents` / `history.missing` fields carry the document inventory. This rule reads them as a text blob because the history object is flattened for rule matching. | 2026-10-27: 修正触发条件 —— 原 `contains_any(['missing','authorization_documents'])` 匹配的是 history 的**键名**，只要存在 authorization_documents 键就命中，把「授权齐全」也判为违规（实测误报）。改为 `history_missing_nonempty`：仅当 missing 列表含具体缺口时命中。该算子需在规则算子枚举中登记。

rules.title: Seller penalty points recorded for the account
rules.description: The account has accumulated penalty points. Penalty points are assigned on Mondays; when the store enters a penalty band the restrictions apply after one week and last 14 to 28 days. A store under a penalty band must have every listing reviewed before publication, because a new violation in that window escalates the restriction.
rules.source_excerpt: Desde 01 de julho, as penalizações não são mais aplicadas de forma imediata: como os pontos de penalidade são atribuídos sempre às segundas-feiras.
rules.notes: The account-level penalty summary is attached to each product's `history` block when the operator supplies it. The rule reads the point count out of that blob.

rules.title: Pending appeal deadline on a penalty point
rules.description: An appeal against a penalty point has a deadline and can be filed only once per violation. A listing that is the subject of a pending appeal must not be republished until the appeal is resolved, because the appeal evidence depends on the listing as it was actioned.
rules.source_excerpt: Você pode recorrer apenas uma vez para cada infração atestada na sua Central do Vendedor.
